name: Fordham 4684 Design Agent — Knowledge Base
purpose: Structured, machine-readable knowledge distilled from building the Fordham 4684 room planners (upstairs bathroom, downstairs shower, sauna). Feeds a design agent that produces geometry-accurate room designs and structure-locked photoreal renders. Units: inches unless noted.
principles: Geometry is ground truth. Placement of walls, cabinets, drains, plumbing rough-ins and glass is deterministic and never invented by a generative model.
Renders are applied ON TOP of locked geometry (a fixed camera snapshot or a site photo), never free text-to-image. Diffusion may add light/reflection/caustics only, never move or resize anything.

Every surface is an independently editable ZONE (each wall run, floor, splash, ceiling, bench, niche). A material change must show on exactly the surface picked and translate identically in 2D and 3D.

Two material paths: (a) PROCEDURAL — colour-true, any colour/size/pattern/grout, editable live; (b) PHOTOGRAPHIC PBR (Look Book) — highest fidelity, fixed baked pattern but scalable to any tile size. Default surfaces to procedural for editability; pin PBR for hero realism.
One finish family across a room: a single metal finish drives every tap/head/bar/ring; one wood tone drives all casework. Never let a per-item swatch drift a fitting off the room finish.
State is the single source of truth and persists (localStorage work-slot + versions). 2D planner, 3D model and floor plan all read the same state.

lightingRules.coveConcealed: Hidden pelmet: LED on the inside of the ceiling frame, a FRONT fascia in the ceiling finish conceals it; you see the wash, not the strip. Warm default. Wash can be up-slab (uplight) or down-the-wall (grazing).
lightingRules.ambientDimmer: One control scales the whole room rig; keep ~35% key for modelling even at the dimmest so it never goes flat-black; feature/emissive lights (cove, niche) stay lit for mood.
lightingRules.practicals: Small point lights parked at real emitters (niche, cove, picture light) so they read as sources; high bloom threshold so only true emitters bloom, never the lit room.

renderFidelity._note: Hard-won technical gotchas — a design agent driving a 3D viewport must honor these or the render reads low-quality.
renderFidelity.antialias: If a bloom EffectComposer is used, its render target bypasses the renderer's MSAA — every edge goes jaggy. Use a multisampled (samples:4) HalfFloat render target, or render direct. Also setPixelRatio on the composer or it renders at half-res on HiDPI.
renderFidelity.tileUV: Reproject planar UVs so U runs horizontal and V vertical (by orientation, NOT by largest axis) or tiles rotate 90 degrees on any wall taller than it is wide, and on raked/extruded geometry.
renderFidelity.tileDepth: Procedural tiles need a companion bump map (grout recessed, tiles proud) + finish sheen + subtle veining + anisotropy + envMapIntensity, or they read flat/CG.
renderFidelity.wood: Casework must carry a photographic grain tinted to the wood tone; a flat colour reads as plastic.
renderFidelity.metalConsistency: Force all metal fittings to the one finish material; a stray per-item swatch leaves a tap/spout a different shade.
renderFidelity.cameraFraming: Ceiling/cove features are invisible from default down-looking presets — add an up-looking camera preset so the user can see them.
renderFidelity.liveSync: When a 2D edit reloads the 3D, persist the orbit camera and restore it, or the view snaps back and feels broken.

stateSchema._note: The shape the apps persist (localStorage work-slot). A design-state JSON the agent emits should follow this.

surfaceZone.lib: MATERIAL_LIBRARY id or null (pin a PBR texture)

renderPipeline.groundTruth: Deterministic 3D stage = locked coords + procedural materializer + camera presets + look book + spec sheet (this project already provides it).
renderPipeline.structureLocked: Take a locked camera snapshot (depth/normal/line render if available) as a ControlNet/structure guide; a diffusion model adds photoreal lighting/reflection/caustics only. NEVER unconstrained text-to-image.
renderPipeline.inpainting: For torn-apart rooms: upload a site photo of studs/subfloor, lasso a region (enclosure/backsplash/floor), apply a finish while masking structural walls + plumbing rough-ins as untouched.
renderPipeline.specSheet: square footage, tile quantities, grout colour/width, paint codes, metal + wood finishes — order-ready.

antiPatterns: Text-to-image a whole room (drains move, cabinets morph, walls distort).
One shared photo texture tinted white so the chosen colour never shows.
matchSurf snapping to a tiny texture pool so colour/size/pattern edits do nothing.
Baking pattern/grout into a material so tile size can't change.
Flat colour wood / flat colour tiles (no bump, no grain) reading as CG.
Per-item metal swatches drifting fittings off the room finish.
Rose gold used where it reads as hot pink.
Building a feature (drop ceiling) with no camera angle that shows it.
Composer without MSAA/pixel-ratio -> the whole render looks pixelated.
